image_description: A close-up, high-resolution shot of an adult bison's head and shoulder hump in profile, facing left. In the bottom right corner, the top of a calf's head is visible, nuzzling or resting against the adult. The background is a soft-focus green field.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is visibly large and broad relative to the frame. One horn is clearly visible, appearing short, thick, and curved upward/inward, consistent with bison anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinctive long, shaggy hair hangs from the chin and throat area, forming the characteristic bison beard.
The visible eye is dark, round, and positioned correctly on the side of the broad head.
No prominent external ear pinnae are visible; the ear region is covered by the dense, shaggy fur of the poll/forehead, which is typical for bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The shoulder hump is extremely prominent and rises significantly above the line of the back, indicating the massive build characteristic of bison.

The image is a close-up crop focusing on the head and shoulders; the hindquarters are outside the frame.

Legs and hooves are completely occluded by the framing of the shot (close-up on head/torso).

The calf's ear structure is ambiguous. It lacks a clear, defined shape and seems to melt slightly into the surrounding fur/head topology. It does not clearly resolve as a distinct anatomical ear.
